title: Roller Coaster Murder Case
subtitle: While on a date with Rachel, Kudo is attacked by two shady thugs who slip him an experimental drug. The effects of the poison will turn Jimmy's life upside down!

title: President's Daughter Kidnapping Case
subtitle: Adjusting to living under his new identity as Conan Edogawa, Shinichi aids Rachel's inept detective father, Richard Moore, in solving the kidnapping of the daughter of a company president.

title: An Idol's Locked Room Murder Case
subtitle: Pop diva Yoko Okino is being stalked and she's come to star-struck Richard Moore's doorstep for help! Luckily for all involved, Conan is on the job, too.

title: The Coded Map of the City Case
subtitle: The Junior Detective League come across a strange map which they believe leads to a treasure and try to decipher it.

title: The Great Bullet Train Explosion
subtitle: While traveling with Ricahrd and Rachel on a train, Conan learns that there is a time bomb hidden on board and has to find it before it detonates.

title: Valentine Murder Case
subtitle: A young man is poisoned during a Valentine's Day gathering and Conan has to figure out exactly how he was poisoned in order to find the killer.

title: Once-a-Month Present Threat Case
subtitle: A surgeon comes to Richard's office to ask him to investigate some gifts he has been receiving once a month for years. Conan soon discovers that they may have a deadly purpose.

title: Art Gallery Owner Murder Case
subtitle: A greedy art gallery owner about to tear the museum down is killed with a sword on camera by someone dressed in a knight's armor.

title: Tenkaichi Night Festival Murder Case
subtitle: When a writer kills his associate during a festival, Conan has to uncover the hole in his alibi and prove him guilty.

title: Pro Soccer Player Blackmail Case
subtitle: Richard is approached by a girl who asks him to track down Jimmy, claiming he used to be her girlfriend. When Conan and Rachel go with her to her house, they help investigate the disappearance of a pro soccer player's little brother.

title: Moonlight Sonata Murder Case
subtitle: Richard is called to Moonlight Island by a mysterious client to investigate a series of murders related to the death of a famous piano player years earlier.

title: Ayumi-chan's Kidnapping Case
subtitle: During a game of hide and seek, Amy finds herself in the trunk of a car with a severed head and a bag of money, leaving it up to the Junior Detective League to track her down and catch the drivers.

title: The Strange Person Hunt Murder Case
subtitle: Richard finds the missing father of a girl named Michelle. Unfortunately, the next day, the father is found murdered and Michelle has vanished. It's up to Conan to find the girl before it's too late!

title: The Mysterious Shooting Message Case
subtitle: As Conan's gang fishes on the riverbank, they witness a most unusual sight. Can they convince Inspector Meguire and Richard of its importance before it's too late?

title: Disappearing Corpse Murder Case
subtitle: When Conan has to deal with a disappearing body, an oddly similar pair of brothers, and a jaded law enforcement system, everything is helter-skelter!

title: The Antique Collector Murder Case
subtitle: What starts out as a lazy day soon takes an exciting turn when an antique collector meets his end by the edge of an ancient sword. Can Conan cut through all the confusion?

title: Department Store Highjacking Case
subtitle: The Junior Detective League find themselves trapped in a department store in the middle of a heist and have to outsmart the burglars.

title: A June Bride Murder Case
subtitle: While Conan suffers through the wedding of a former teacher, someone is plotting to poison the bride's favorite drink! What diabolical mind is behind this act of evil?

title: An Elevator Murder Case
subtitle: What began as an enjoyable day for Conan, Richard, and Rachel, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model, soon turns toxic. A beautiful young lady has been found dead!

title: A Haunted Mansion Murder Case
subtitle: Conan, George, Mitch, and Amy explore a haunted house. With strange noises and mysterious screams around every corner, what they find is more bizarre than any ghost ever imagined.

title: On Location, TV Drama Murder Case
subtitle: When a crewmember is killed, a movie set becomes a crime scene! Everyone involved in the movie is labeled a suspect, but who could be capable of such a horrendous deed?

title: Luxury Liner Serial Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Conan, Richard and Rachel are present when the patriarch of a wealthy, dysfunctional family is found stabbed to death on the family's private luxury liner.

title: Luxury Liner Serial Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Lucas becomes the next victim on the voyage, and it's revealed that Theodore's escape from his makeshift cell was only possible with an accomplice. Amid two-timing and back-stabbing, Conan's on the case.

title: The Mysterious Woman with Amnesia Case
subtitle: During Richard's day at the track, he must dodge a revenge-driven ex-con and help a beautiful woman recover her memories.

title: The False Kidnapping and Hostage Case
subtitle: A dramatic car chase leaves two people dead - or does it? What does a diving watch, a sun tan, and five million dollars add up to? Just another puzzling case for Conan.

title: Pet Dog Jon Murder Case
subtitle: A dog named Jack kills a college student, shocking the dog's owner and Conan as well! Conan's known the pooch forever, and if he doesn't get to the bottom of the attack, Jack will be put to sleep!

title: Kogoro's Class Reunion Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Conan and Rachel tag along with Richard for his college reunion. One attendant is found dead in what appears to be a suicide, though Conan is convinced that it's murder.

title: Kogoro's Class Reunion Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: When Richard realizes that the death he's dealing with is not a suicide but a murder and that the perpetrator is one of his old friends, Conan tries to subtly give him hints to help him solve the case.

title: The Computer Murder Case
subtitle: A chance meeting with a corporate executive lands Conan in the middle of a murder investigation. A curious cat, a suspicious limo driver, and pile of melted chocolates have Conan wondering who the killer is.

title: Alibi Testimony Murder Case
subtitle: A famous lawyer calls for Kogoro at a fancy hotel asking him to follow his wife who may be having an affair. Kogoro, Ran and Conan then going to the man's house discover that the wife in question has been murdered.

title: TV Station Murder Case
subtitle: During a Primetime TV Mystery show, a man who worked at the station was shot in the head. Though no one had come into the room at the time. How was the murder committed?

title: Coffee Shop Murder Case
subtitle: Ran tells Conan she's meeting someone at a coffee shop. Conan suspecting something, follows Ran. Meanwhile, a murder is committed at the coffee shop. But who?

title: Detective Boys' Survival Case
subtitle: A treasure hunt turns scary for the Junior Detective League. They're lost in the wild, miles from civilization, and two suspicious-looking men are sneaking around!

title: The Mountain Villa Bandaged Man Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: When Conan, Rachel and Serena attend the reunion of a film club at a mansion in the woods, an ax-wielding, cloaked man covered with bandages stalks them and attacks them in the night.

title: The Mountain Villa Bandaged Man Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: A group of Rachel's old friends seek to defend themselves against a deadly axe-murderer. But is the assailant really stalking them from outside of the villa - or is he lurking within?

title: Monday Night 7:30pm Murder Case
subtitle: When a real estate agent is murdered in his condo, the police suspect a well-known dentist in town. Will Conan's investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?

title: Cactus Flower Murder Case
subtitle: When a pretty girl hires Detective Moore to help her find an old flame, Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé.

title: Akaoni Village Fire Festival Murder Case
subtitle: When a man Richard was hired to follow is murdered, he realizes that the victim's life insurance beneficiary is guilty, leaving it up to Conan to find a hole in his seemingly perfect alibi, which has been provided by Richard.

title: The Wealthy Daughter Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Conan, Rachel and Richard attend the birthday party of a millionaire's daughter. When they get stranded at her family's mansion along with some guests, bodies start turning up after the birthday girl goes missing.

title: The Wealthy Daughter Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: When a beautiful heiress is murdered on her birthday, Conan springs into action to solve the baffling crime. The stakes are soon raised, as Rachel becomes a target for the assassin's sinister game.

title: The Victory Flag Vandalism Case
subtitle: A baseball game is interrupted when the School Chairman reveals that someone has slashed the cherished Championship Flag! Scandal rocks Shore View High as Conan investigates.

title: A Karaoke Box Murder Case
subtitle: A rock star about to go solo is poisoned at a karaoke bar, and the prime suspects are his soon-to-be former band members. As Conan investigates, he discovers that a terrible tragedy is behind the murder.

title: Conan Edogawa Kidnapping Case
subtitle: A lady who claims to be Conan's mother might really be a spy working for the organization that poisoned him! Can Conan escape from her murderous intentions and find an antidote for the poison?

title: The Three Hotta Siblings Murder Case
subtitle: Richard, Rachel, and Conan land in the middle of a murder mystery surrounding the death of billionaire. Conan must face one disturbing reality: the prime suspects are the victim's children.

title: The Facial Mask Murder Case
subtitle: Richard stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she was expecting company?

title: Snowy Mountain Villa Murder Case
subtitle: Conan, Richard and Rachel get trapped in a mountain villa when a doctor is murdered. Conan soon discovers that the victim left behind some clues about the identity of his killer.

title: OVA Conan vs. Kid vs. Yaiba - The Grand Battle for the Treasure Sword!!
subtitle: Kogorou Mouri is asked by the Mine family to protect the treasured sword in their dojo, as Kaitou Kid has sent a note of his intent to steal it. Upon arriving at the dojo, Conan and the others meet Yaiba Kurogane.

title: The Missing Melody
subtitle: When an attorney's wife is murdered under strange circumstances, Conan steps in to make sense of it all. A music box, a telephone call, and a staple all point to a killer no one would expect.

title: Murder at the Television Studio
subtitle: Richard Moore stars on the popular television show Prime Time Mystery Hour, and while Conan and Rachel enjoy the broadcast from the audience, a vicious murder takes place at the studio.

title: Murder at the Local Diner
subtitle: Rachel has a date and Conan is determined to find out who this guy is. But when a brutal murder takes place at the diner he's in, Conan steps into his detective shoes to solve the case.

title: The Last Dive
subtitle: Saijo Naoya, the reigning diving champion, has apparently drowned to death; he was diving in the dark and struck his head on another diving board. Conan notes the earplugs are not the same brand that the victim usually wears.

title: No Immunity for the Diplomat: Part 1
subtitle: Conan, Richard and Rachel are joined by Harley Hartwell, a teen detective from the west coast, in solving the sealed room murder of a diplomat.

title: No Immunity for the Diplomat: Part 2
subtitle: Jimmy Kudo returns to the surprise of everyone, especially himself! As Jimmy tries to expose the real secret behind the perfectly sealed room, the rivalry between he and Harley Hartwell heats up!

title: The Book Without Pages
subtitle: A nice afternoon at the library turns into a search or corpse when an attendant goes missing. Conan and his friends decide to they late but then are trapped in the library. Can they catch the killer?

title: Driving a Bomb
subtitle: At a golf course, the president of a electronics manufacturer is murdered and Conan and his friends must figure out the mystery.

title: The Mist Goblin Murder
subtitle: A seemingly impossible murder is committed at a mountain temple - and the Mist Goblin is the prime suspect! Luckily Conan and Richard are on the scene!

title: Nazo no Kyouki Satsujin Jiken
subtitle: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran find a injured bird on the ground and hear a scream, they find a woman who is screaming about how her husband is dead and the murder victim on the balcony.

title: Game Gone Bad
subtitle: Kogoro gets invited to a party for a game which he stars in. Conan runs into a man who uses the name 'Tequila' and finds out he is going to meet Gin and Vodka. Conan follows him to the bathroom where a explosion happens.

title: The Train Trick Murder Case
subtitle: Conan's got a maddening new riddle: If a train departs the station at 10:30, and another train arrives at 10:35, how can a man on one train kill a man on the other?

title: The Oja Ocean Sunfish Murder Case
subtitle: Conan's on the case when the manager of a cleaning company is crushed by a piece of steel, but he encounters only dead ends in the alleyway where the murder was committed.

title: Footsteps of the Hero: Part 1
subtitle: Conan enters a Sherlock Holmes contest and wins a rare book, then everyone has to take a 1000 question question test about Sherlock Holmes. The host of the contest drives his car off a cliff.

title: Footsteps of the Hero: Part 2
subtitle: After Conan reveals his deductions, Heiji believes Conan is actually Shinichi. Heiji reveals that Harry had already undergone rigor mortis while in the car. Conan tranquilizes Heiji, not wanting to risk using Kogoro, and accuses Alex Carr.

title: Hajimete no Otsukai Satsujin Jiken
subtitle: A young boy is the target of a killer. Conan and his friends have to use of their skills to protect him.

title: Illustrated Murder
subtitle: Kenjin Hanaoka a a painter has everything he could want and living the good life, but then he decides to have an affair with one of his pretty illustrators, his life falls apart. Hanaoka decides to cover his actions up in murder. Can Conan expose him for who he really is?

title: Sports Club Murder Case
subtitle: The rivalry between two divers boils over as the reigning champ is found dead. It looks as if this death was nothing more than a tragic accident, but Conan knows that nothing is ever as it seems.

title: Ghost Ship Murder: Part 2
subtitle: Unknown

title: Gomera!
subtitle: Conan and his friends visit the movie set of their favorite monster, Gomera and find a murder.

title: Library Murder Case
subtitle: Having found a remedy for the poison that shrunk him, Conan decides to play with the Detective Boys one more time and spends it at the library, where a librarian has a deadly secret hidden in the books and a murder on his conscience.

title: The Golf Driving Range Murder Case
subtitle: A relaxing day at the driving range leads Conan, Richard, and Rachel to their next explosive case, as the president of a leading electronics manufacturer meets an untimely end.

title: The Mystery Weapon Murder Case
subtitle: When a man is found murdered, three suspects emerge. But even if one of them committed the crime, how did they do it when none of them were anywhere near the victim? That's what Conan intends to figure out!

title: Game Company Murder Case
subtitle: Conan comes back on the trail of the Black Organization when one of its members is killed by a bomb at a game exhibit.

title: Holmes Freak Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: When Conan, Richard and Rachel attend a gathering for Sherlock Holmes aficionados, the host, who had promised a grand prize for a quiz, is murdered in strange circumstances.

title: Holmes Freak Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: The murderer is still on the loose and his methods have even the most diehard Sherlock Holmes fans completely baffled. The mystery thickens as Conan tries to crack the case!

title: The First Errand Murder Case
subtitle: The Junior Detective League is back on the case when a young boy becomes the unknowing target of a killer! Conan and his friends must use every trick in their book to protect the tiny tot.

title: An Illustrator Murder Case
subtitle: A popular illustrator finds his life falling apart after an affair with a young colleague. Rather than face his mistakes, he tries to cover them up in brutal fashion. Can Conan see through his ingenious plot?

title: A Ghost Ship Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: When a boat believed to have been lost in a storm along with a fortune in gold drifts into harbor after several years, its cargo missing, the locals hire Richard to locate the treasure.

title: The Shipwreck Murder
subtitle: Unknown

title: Jinnai, King of Death
subtitle: Unknown

title: The Third Fingerprint Murder Case
subtitle: When a veteran of the police force kills a mob informant during what appears to be a struggle, Conan suspects that he's lying about it being an act of self-defense.

title: Phantom Thief 1412
subtitle: Unknown

title: Mysterious Masked Murder: Part 1
subtitle: Unknown

title: Stage Actress Murder Case
subtitle: While Richard is hired to find out who sent a threatening letter to a stage actress, his old mentor pays him a visit and becomes involved when the actress is poisoned during a rehearsal.

title: The Revengeful Robber
subtitle: Unknown

title: Dead Hobo
subtitle: Unknown

title: Two Times Trouble: Part 1
subtitle: Unknown

title: Two Times Trouble: Part 2
subtitle: Unknown

title: General Hospital Murder Case
subtitle: The Set Up -- Richard witnesses a murder in the hospital, but his eyes may be playing tricks on him: he sees the same scene four nights in a row. Things get even stranger when he emerges as the prime suspect.

title: Ski Lodge Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Massacre Night (Part 1) -- Conan, Rachel and Serena get stranded at a ski lodge with an old teacher while someone is hiding in the dark and strangling the residents in the night.

title: Ski Lodge Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Massacre Night (Part 2) -- After Serena was attacked, the words MASSACRE NIGHT were found written on her hand. Conan leaps into action to uncover the truth, but sometimes the truth is too much to handle.

title: The Kidnapping Location Case
subtitle: Find the Kidnap Site -- The Junior Detective League is after a kidnapper who has dubious intentions. There's more than one life at stake if Conan can't figure out where the captive child is hidden.

title: The Crane's Return of a Favor Murder Case
subtitle: For the Birds -- Conan and Rachel take Richard on a crane-watching trip, but the man responsible for the birds' well being is found murdered. The victim's son turns himself in, but Conan suspects the guy is innocent.

title: Dracula Villa Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Vampire Villa (Part 1) -- Richard is hired by a horror novelist to find out with whom his wife is having an affair. Later the same evening, the man is killed in a ritualistic manner and all of the house guests turn out to have motives.

title: Dracula Villa Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Vampire Villa (Part 2) -- Horror novelist Stefan Van Croven has been pierced through the chest with a wooden stake. Richard is convinced that the answer is right under his nose, but he doesn't know that Conan's figured out the trick.

title: The Flower's Smell Murder Case
subtitle: Deadly Art -- Richard is asked to investigate a murder threat against Rika Okano, a respected artist who is up for an award. The threat is simple: If Rika receives the award, she will be murdered.

title: Hospitalized Burgulary Suspect Case
subtitle: Hospital Homicide -- After Richard breaks his leg, Conan's stops by to visit and senses all is not right with Moore's hospital roommates. His suspicions are justified when a high stakes game of kidnapping and murder begins.

title: The Fearful Mountain Trek Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Mountain Fox (Part 1) -- Richard, Rachel and Conan join a client who has hired an assassin known as "the Fox" to kill him to a hike in the mountain to stop the assassin, who turns out to be a member of the party when a guide is killed.

title: The Fearful Mountain Trek Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Mountain Fox (Part 2) -- Conan is faced with the task of tracking the Fox, the world's most notorious assassin, after the mysterious death of two campers. Can Conan stop him from killing again?

title: Snow Woman Legend Murder Case
subtitle: The Other Girl -- A wonderland of wintertime fun becomes a stage for tragedy following the death of an actress at the peak of her career. But a suicide note and a history of poor health don't always add up to the obvious.

title: A Ghost Ship Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Richard faces a murder wrap and it's up to Conan to clear his name. In order to solve the mystery, the young sleuth realizes he must go where no one else will: into the eerie darkness of the Pirates' Cave!

title: Big Monster Gomera Murder Case
subtitle: The Junior Detective League visits the film set of their favorite monster, Gomera. When they stumble onto a real-life murder, the most puzzling aspect of the case is the prime suspect: Gomera!

title: Night Road Murder Case
subtitle: How can blood from a murder on the street end up on the wall of an abandoned building, on the railing of a rooftop, and on the broken glass of an upper-apartment window? This is the question Conan must answer.

title: A Crab and Whale Kidnapping Case
subtitle: A relaxing night turns into a search for a kidnapped little boy. As Conan, Richard, and Rachel try to find the truth, nothing is certain except the kidnapper's deadly ultimatum: no police, no mercy, no time!

title: Night Baron Murder Case (Case Part)
subtitle: Conan and the Moores attend a mystery tour involving the Night Baron, a character from the books written by Shinichi's father, at a beach hotel.

title: Night Baron Murder Case (Suspicion Part)
subtitle: The tour takes a deadly turn when one of the guests falls from a room and is impaled on a statue.

title: Night Baron Murder Case (Resolution Part)
subtitle: Conan closes in on the killer's identity when he realizes something he missed earlier. Meanwhile, Rachel suspects that an idol of her's, a karate champion staying at the hotel, is involved.

title: A Stalker's Murder Case
subtitle: Richard, Conan, and Rachel discover a corpse in the street. While the police believe the incident to be a random murder, the victim's past leads Conan to pin the blame on the most unassuming suspect of all!

title: The Triplet's Country Home Murder Case
subtitle: Conan and Rachel find themselves embroiled in a murder at a private beach. However, even more disturbing than the brutal death is the list of prime suspects: the victim's triplet sons!

title: The Detective Boys' Disaster Case
subtitle: An S.O.S. message in a bottle disrupts Conan's beachside vacation. Can he and his Junior Detective League friends find the young woman they believe to be the note's author?

title: The Death God Jinnai Murder Case
subtitle: When a killer claiming to be the King of Death sends a threat to movie star, Conan, Richard, and Rachel must stop the culprit from making good on his warning: At the stroke of Midnight, you will die!

title: The Loan Company President's Murder Case
subtitle: Mahjong: a game of strategy, skill, and luck - three things that a sinister murderer hopes he has on his side! Conan must stack the clues and place details in order if he is to win this terrifying game!

title: Conan vs. Kaitou Kid
subtitle: Conan enters a battle of wits with an elusive master thief known as Kaito Kid and has to stop him from stealing a precious pearl from Sonoko's family aboard a cruise ship.

title: A Distinguished Family's Consecutive Accidental Death Case: Part 1
subtitle: When Richard is hired to find wealthy Gerard Dufour's childhood sweetheart, a murder takes place right under his nose - and the prime suspect turns up dead.

title: A Distinguished Family's Consecutive Accidental Death Case: Part 2
subtitle: Conan and Harley Hartwell's covert investigation continues. But with precious few suspects, one big question haunts the brilliant duo: If Roland Dufour didn't commit the murder, then who did?

title: The Bank Heist Murder Case
subtitle: Conan and Rachel become embroiled in a bank robbery that ends in murder. Just when Inspector Meguire thinks he's solved the crime, Conan discovers a hidden agenda that busts the case wide-open!

title: The Wandering Artist Murder Case
subtitle: When the Junior Detective League sets out to help an ailing homeless man, they end up involved in a new murder mystery. They know who did it - but can they get anyone to listen to them?

title: The Kidnapping of a Popular Artist Case: Part 1
subtitle: Conan and the Junior Detective League were playing kick the can near a theater hall. Conan found Ran and Sonoke walking along with the crowd of people. Conan asked what was being held at the theater. They explain to him that a concert is being held there. Takayama Minami & Nagano Shiina also known as TWO-MIX are going to be performing there. Ran and Sonoke hope to see them before the concert begins. After they left Conan with the Genta, Ayumi, & Mitsuhiko. The 4 kids bumped into a woman, who they recognized as Takayama Minami. Minami didn't want to draw attention which is why she's wearing a hat, sunglasses, & sports jacket. She treated them to lunch before they broke her cover. For a bonus she let them listen to a Demo tape that TWO-MIX hasn't released yet. Minami received a call from Shiina who was in the car parked outside. Telling her to come meet him. When Minami went near the car, she discovered that Shiina was knocked out cold in the back seat. And they was forced inside the car by a tall guy. The car drove away as soon as the kidnapping took place. Conan and his friends went back to the theater hall to tell the manager what had happen. Which was the same time the police & Inspector Megure came after the manager got a threat call from the kidnappers that they have TWO-MIX. Another phone call came, this time the kidnappers instructed them on what their motives are. It isn't money they want, it's the demo tape, which is still in the possession of Conan and the Junior Detective League. The kidnappers made a deal for them to drop off the demo tape at a designated place or TWO-MIX will face certain doom. Inspector Megure finds it all to be a risk. But Conan and the Junior Detective League is up to the negotiation. With the police close to their side. Conan hopes to save TWO-MIX before their concert start. What do the kidnappers want with the demo tape?

title: The Kidnapping of a Popular Artist Case: Part 2
subtitle: Conan takes the place of Ayumi to deliver the demo tape to the kidnappers. While the Junior Detective League were left with Conan's detecting view glasses which gives out the location of where Conan and TWO-MIX are. When they got to the hideout where TWO-MIX was held tied up. They were all cornered by one of the kidnappers: Miyahara Satoshi. Who was taken off a murder case he was involved last New Year's eve. And the demo tape contained lyrics of what TWO-MIX over heard from what really happen during the murder. The lyric itself is evidence enough to put Satoshi behind bars. So to avoid the risk of the police hearing the song on the radio. He lite the hideout on fire and locked the front door to let Conan, TWO-MIX, and the kids burn alive. Can Conan and the others escape from the inferno hideout? And will TWO-MIX make it back to the concert?

title: Kogoro's Date Murder Case
subtitle: Richard's Deadly Date -- Richard's set to reunite with a childhood friend, but what happens is more than Richard ever could have imagined. What do an old ink pen, a security camera, and three children add up to? Murder.

title: Caught Up with the Great Detective! Two Murder Cases
subtitle: Jimmy Kudo Revealed (Part 1-4) -- Rachel becomes suspicious of Conan when she notices that he looks a lot like Jimmy when he was his age. Meanwhile, Conan becomes involved in the investigations of the murders of a magician and a friend of his mother's.

title: The Farewell Wine Murder Case
subtitle: The Farewell Wine Murder Case -- Richard is hired by a retiring billionaire to stop his daughters from killing him for the inheritance. When he is poisoned, Conan realizes that there is more to his death than meets the eye.

title: The Famous Potter Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Potter's Gambit (Part 1) -- While visiting a famous potter, Conan, Richard, and Rachel stumble upon what they believe to be a suicide - but was it? As the detectives soon learn, looks can often times be deceiving.

title: The Famous Potter Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Potter's Gambit (Part 2) -- Conan tries to unravel the mystery of Margery Taylor's apparent suicide, but how can he prove a murder took place when all of the suspects - including Richard, Rachel, and himself - share the same alibi?

title: The Memories of First Love Case: Part 1
subtitle: The Memories of First Love (Part 1) -- Rachel and Conan join Annette, one of Jimmy's old flames, on a weekend getaway. When the villa catches fire, Rachel risks her life to save her competition. Was the fire an accident? Or is something sinister afoot?

title: The Memories of First Love Case: Part 2
subtitle: The Memories of First Love (Part 2) -- Conan quickly figures out the complicated method the arsonist used to torch the house, as well as the motive behind it. But after the case is solved, Jimmy is in for an embarrassing surprise of his own.

title: Historical Play Performer Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Fame and Misfortune (Part 1) -- A movie star hires Richard to advise him for a role as a detective. But the line between fact and fiction blurs when Richard, Rachel, and Conan discover they have front row seats to an act of murder.

title: Historical Play Performer Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Fame and Misfortune (Part 2) -- As the media flocks to the high-profile murder case, the police prepare to charge a movie star with murder. Can Conan prove he knows who actually committed the crime?

title: The Mysterious Robbers and Mansion Case: Part 1
subtitle: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor (Part 1) -- When Conan and Rachel join Richard for a trip to Bludcraven Manor, they learn of a troubling secret that may link Morfius Bludcraven, the original lord of the estate, to a band of thieves known as The Goblins.

title: The Mysterious Robbers and Mansion Case: Part 2
subtitle: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor (Part 2) -- Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to decipher a secret code that promises to solve the strange mysteries of Bludcraven Manor. The unsuspecting sleuths have no clue that the goblins they hunt are very real.

title: Scoop Picture Murder Case
subtitle: Snapshots of Death -- When a photographer wins an award for capturing a fire on film, it seems like his career has been made - but when Richard accuses him of being a murderer on TV, one of their careers is about to go up in smoke.

title: Mogura Star Man Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: The Mystery Moletian Case (Part 1) -- A distraught man visits Richard about his murdered sister, but things just don't add up. A jewelry store heist and a car chase lead Conan back to the scene of the crime as another case unfolds.

title: Mogura Star Man Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: The Mystery Moletian Case (Part 2) -- A suspected murder, a jewel heist, and a missing body have Conan and the Junior Detective League working every angle to crack the case. Will Conan be able to put the clues together in time?

title: Detective Club Pursuit Case
subtitle: Hit and Run -- When a killer spies the Junior Detective League on TV, he decides to use them for his own evil purposes. Can Conan and his pals see through his plan or will they unwittingly help him get away with murder?

title: Cooking Classroom Murder Case: Part 1
subtitle: Recipe for Murder (Part 1) -- When Rachel and Serena attend a cooking class and the teacher is stabbed in the back with a very thin weapon during a blackout, Conan realizes that the killer is one of her students and the weapon is hidden somewhere in the classroom.

title: Cooking Classroom Murder Case: Part 2
subtitle: Recipe for Murder (Part 2) -- All four suspects had a reason to stab their cooking instructor in the back. But what was the murder weapon, where is it hidden, and how was the killer able to strike in a pitch-black kitchen?
